idea-plugin.name: Connection String & Secret Audit
idea-plugin.description:
26 rules and 32 safe-replacement snippets for hardcoded connection strings, keys and kubeconfigs across 8 VS Code stacks. Runs on your machine and sends nothing anywhere.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Connection String & Secret Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 26 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/connection-string-secret-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/connection-string-secret-audit

action.text: Connection String & Secret Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Connection String & Secret Audit on the file in the editor
